The Thanksgiving planner will help you to plan all aspects of this beautiful event! The editable Canva planner templates have been created to help you plan out your entire menu, meal prep, and recipes. Create your own holiday planner bundle and get your house ready for guests and make all the necessary Thanksgiving preparations. Simply edit this template with the free version of Canva – you can change the entire design, including fonts, colors, elements, and much more to create your Thanksgiving binder! A free Canva guide for beginners is included.

And Much More!

This template can be edited with a free Canva account. You can easily change colors, fonts, arrange the pages, add the pages you need, delete the ones you don’t, add any elements and twists, and create your own planner. You will need basic knowledge of Canva to use this template. You will need to edit this template on your computer. You can sign up for a FREE.

You can either print the PDFs as they are and start planning.

You will get 2 files.
1 PDF file contains the Canva template. For Thanksgiving Planner, Fully Editable
1 PDF file contains BASIC CANVA TEMPLATE EDITING GUIDE

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Download your file after purchase
2. Click the link in the PDF
3. Create a free account with Canva (if you don’t already have one)
4. Edit the template: font, color, social media handle, and more
5. Print at home or by using a printing service (Canva does offer printing)
